name: Todoroki
tagline: Shibuya in 25 minutes and Shinagawa in 31 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 48 minutes to Otemachi, 35 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 31 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 27.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 12.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 27.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 27.2 m to 39.2 m, a difference of 12.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 和乃会小倉病院, about 17 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 世田谷記念病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Oimachi Line.
congestion: Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 九品仏→自由が丘, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Oyamadai; for lower rent, Todoroki.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Todoroki. It is served by the same lines as Todoroki. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥9,000 more at Oyamadai. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Oyamadai comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Todoroki is ahead on how close the centre is and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Todoroki. It is served by the same lines as Todoroki. To Toranomon, for instance, Kaminoge takes 3 minutes longer. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Todoroki comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 目黒通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 2 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Oimachi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
